disease_assertion.endpoint: WWOX protein detectable by Western blot (lysate fraction not separated)
disease_assertion.source: claim_registry_current CLAIM 019 (functional source: PAPER 041, a single-laboratory study)
disease_assertion.locator: CLAIM 019, paragraph 'DATO FUNZIONALE, CAUSA NON RISOLTA'; PAPER 041
disease_assertion.measured_result_note: Transcript comparable to reference lines, protein band not detected. One membrane, one exposure, one donor line, no healthy fibroblast control, no densitometry, no n. No proteasome inhibitor, chaperone, synthesis, solubility or half-life measurement exists; the authors leave open impaired translation or premature degradation. The endpoint is 'mRNA normal + protein not detected', not a post-translational mechanism.

drug_assertions.target_id: p53, dystrophin and CFTR PTC-containing mRNA and protein
drug_assertions.source: the originating 2012 NMD-screen paper (known-roads reading 1, 22938201); NOT WWOX EVIDENCE

context.disease_id: TP53, DMD and CFTR nonsense alleles (not WWOX)
context.cell_type: lung-cancer line, DMD myocytes, CF airway epithelial line

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: In the p53 line a truncated protein was well detected and only a very low level of full-length protein; no wild-type-referenced fraction of function; concentration-response non-monotonic; allele- and context-specific by the authors' account.

drug_assertions.target_id: survival, chromosomal aberrations and micronuclei (phenotypic rescue)
drug_assertions.endpoint: phenotypic rescue head-to-head with a comparator read-through agent
drug_assertions.source: independent Fanconi-anaemia study (known-roads reading 2, 40544182); NOT WWOX EVIDENCE

context.genotype: patient nonsense alleles in FANCA and FANCF

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: MEASURED NO PHENOTYPIC RESCUE (survival, aberrations, micronuclei) and NMD not relieved, while full-length protein was induced in one arm (FANCA, about 9 percent of control) and not in the other; the endpoint encoded here is the phenotypic rescue only, so the protein induction is stated in this note and not in the direction code; the effect that was seen is attributed by the authors to TBK1/IKKe inhibition, not read-through. Encoded NO_CHANGE for the phenotypic endpoint.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: Production of full-length WWOX protein from an allele carrying a premature stop codon, then function; proximal readout: full-length versus truncated protein on N- and C-terminal reagents plus a WWOX function assay.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: None for WWOX. Elsewhere: partial in one gene, a relevant negative on phenotypic rescue in the only comparator-controlled study.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Non-neural human cell lines, nonsense alleles only; no animal, no neural, no missense arm.

cellular_context.target_expression: UNKNOWN. Nonsense alleles exist in the WWOX records, but no PTC-context annotation (stop identity, +4 nucleotide) or count exists.
cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: Lung-cancer, myocyte, airway-epithelial, lymphoblastoid and dermal fibroblast lines; none neural.
cellular_context.coverage: Allele and context specificity is stated by the originating authors: no effect size transfers from one PTC to another.
cellular_context.limits: The reference missense allele has no premature stop codon. Read-through is not a mechanism for it at any dose by any agent. Other pharmacological actions of the molecule (NMD inhibition, TBK1/IKKe inhibition) are separate hypotheses, untested in any WWOX system.

p4_card.identity: Amlexanox, identified in a >1200-compound marketed-drug library screen for NMD inhibition; formulation relevant to any use: UNKNOWN.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WOREE as target only for PTC-bearing WWOX alleles. For the Q230P-class reference missense the mechanism is structurally inapplicable. The WWOX Foundation's reported individual experience and a 2024 poster abstract are one narrated experience and one uncontrolled account of it: not two replications and not confirmed efficacy.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA for WWOX: seven registry surfaces 0 records; PubMed 'amlexanox AND WWOX' 0 and the read-through-agent query 0, 2026-10-20 (known-roads § 4.1). Limits: a drug-name zero reaches titles and abstracts, not Methods; unpublished foundation-reported experience is unreachable by construction; the instrument was shown to read (17 amlexanox read-through records elsewhere).
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: not verified for WWOX; elsewhere partial and a relevant negative on phenotypic rescue.
p4_card.expected_contribution: Full-length protein from a PTC allele, function of it unmeasured; no contribution is stated for the missense class.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: translation termination at a premature stop codon and, separately, NMD; the dual mechanism is declared unresolved in its originating paper; direction: full-length protein up; context: nonsense alleles in non-neural cells.

for: mRNA rose and protein appeared in three nonsense models of the originating study.
against: The full-length species can be the minor one.

Independent comparator-controlled study: no phenotypic rescue, NMD not relieved; the authors write: "Thus, this study suggests that a partial downregulation of p53 per se is not sufficient to produce phenotypic rescue in human cells."
The entire safety argument in the originating paper is historic use for other indications; no paediatric, CNS or pharmacokinetic datum.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: No missense arm anywhere; allele- and context-specific by the authors' account.

p4_card.pharmacology: UNKNOWN for WWOX. No pharmacokinetic or CNS datum in the sources.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: The dual-activity claim is not reproduced outside its originating laboratory; the two papers disagree on the NMD arm and this card does not adjudicate which is right.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: Both readings are partial_fulltext_read with figures captions_only; supplement of the independent study not fetched (declared debt).

p4_card.next_measurement: For PTC alleles: a transcript-level NMD measurement on a recorded nonsense allele (the sequence-based enumeration exists since 2026-10-28 as a prediction only), then a function measurement on any protein produced. For the missense class: none, the mechanism does not apply.
p4_card.status_reason: Ineligible by mechanism for the reference missense; for PTC alleles the eligible class is counted only as a sequence prediction (32 alleles, NMD classes predicted, none measured).
p4_card.value_added: Keeps a qualified road visible without letting protein quantity stand for function.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; the only synonym-driven record is one observational natural-history registry. Carried with the census's own caution: "A missing hit does not prove that no study exists." It answers seven queries against one registry on one date; unregistered, differently worded, non-NLM or later-registered studies are not excluded.

not_known: Whether any WWOX PTC allele would be read through, and at what efficiency: the PTC alleles are enumerated only as a sequence prediction (32 alleles, 23 predicted NMD-sensitive), with no NMD or read-through measurement.
Whether full-length protein produced by read-through of a WWOX PTC would function.

About 57 percent of classifiable individuals in the largest genotype-classified cohort are null/null (56.8 percent in the abstract of the 2025 Neurology cohort of 50 individuals from 45 families, PMID 40875931, confirmed by PubMed abstract on 2026-10-21; the null class pools nonsense, frameshift, splice and deletion alleles, so it is not a nonsense count): for them no recoverable endogenous substrate for any allele-specific lever is established.
evidence_against: No phenotypic rescue in the one comparator-controlled study.
No premature stop codon in the reference missense.

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
NO_MATCH_FOUND is not 'does not exist'; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA is not MAI_TENTATO.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
